requiredEvidence.historicalEpochs: Retain every prior final evidence hash, gaps and quarantined identities; no automatic reset or silent deletion
requiredEvidence.clock: Same-boot completed host/container clock probe at least the intended bounded interval; fresh coherent wall/monotonic ages; never count sleep
requiredEvidence.startBoundary: Reviewed finalized anchor/lookback per venue from independently operated authenticated providers; exact start completeness must be demonstrated
requiredEvidence.providers: Document actual independently authenticated operator provenance; identical finalized transaction and defensible common market-account bank/owners/bytes/deployment; minContextSlot is not equality
requiredEvidence.currentCoverage: All subscriptions ACKed, receipts current, no unknown gap, unreviewed conflict or quarantined processing; pagination limits remain partial/unrecoverable
requiredEvidence.protocol: Reviewed source/deployment/account/fee/custody model, precise unsigned wires and two-sided simulation evidence for the specific variant
requiredEvidence.freshness: Keep existing finalized-paper-research or stricter policy; no history/restart receipt promoted to live, original times and slots retained
requiredEvidence.ownership: One shared filesystem owner and sticky stop. Crashes require offline reconciliation; no inferred foreign PID lease takeover

invalidation: Clock discontinuity or unexplained process pause
Transport incident/ACK failure or stale receipts
Zero/unverifiable transaction identity, state/byte conflict or unknown predecessor
Unknown provider identity, changed deployment or unsupported account layout
explicitIndependentDecisionRequired: An external reviewer must justify any research-only isolation of a proven clean current window from retained historical gaps. Empty queue/new UUID is insufficient. This proposal does not implement or claim that approval.
